capabilities: Set vim key bindings on or off per device type
Apply the per-device choice each time Obsidian starts
Configure separate values for desktop and mobile
Skip writing app.json when the setting already matches
extras: Uses Obsidian's undocumented internal config methods (app.vault.getConfig/setConfig), which the README warns could change in a future release; manual toggles in Obsidian's settings are overridden on next startup.
intentEvidence: turns Vim key bindings on or off depending on the kind of device Obsidian is running on
motivation: Vim key bindings work well with a hardware keyboard but are painful on a phone's touch keyboard, and the shared setting cannot tell devices apart.
problem: The Vim mode setting lives in the vault's shared config, so with any vault sync, enabling it on a laptop also forces it onto a phone's touch keyboard.
summary: Per-device settings toggle that turns Obsidian's Vim key bindings on or off separately for desktop and mobile devices.
